detail.body:
## Background

A review of recent inference changes on `main` found that `StreamingChatParser`, which drives OpenAI-compatible streaming in the dynamic text-gen server, commits reasoning deltas as soon as the reasoning parser returns them. A later chunk can still move that text, and text that was already streamed cannot be taken back.

## What changed

- `openai_streaming.py`: while reasoning is still open, hold back a trailing partial end marker (for example `</thi`, or a partial implicit marker such as `<tool_call>`) instead of streaming it as reasoning. This adds `_partial_marker_start` (now also used by `_safe_content_prefix`) and `_safe_reasoning_prefix`.
- `StreamingChatParser` takes two new arguments, `reasoning_markers` and `force_content`. Some parsers return reasoning as content until a non-empty answer follows, then move it back to reasoning. NemotronV3 does this with `enable_thinking=False` or `force_nonempty_content=True`. For those parsers no deltas are sent until the split is stable. The parser is either named explicitly or detected by a one-time probe of `parse`. The final parse flushes everything.
- Logprobs of tokens whose text the parser holds back are no longer dropped. They are buffered per choice (`pending_logprobs`) and attached to the next chunk that carries text, including the final flush.
- New unit tests in `tests/unit_tests/inference/test_openai_streaming.py`, including `test_openai_stream_keeps_logprobs_of_parser_held_back_text`. It covers a final flush with and without additional tokens.

## Details

The callers are `endpoints/chat_completions.py` and `endpoints/completions.py`. There are no dependency or lock changes.

The branch merges `main` at `ee6baa2e` (#8263, which seeds CPU initialization in the checkpoint load test that timed out on an earlier head). Against that base it changes only the two files above.

Review 5547002215 (logprobs dropped for held-back text) is fixed in `9bd15b20`. Review 5547215667 on this head reports no findings.

## Tested

- black, isort, pylint (10.00/10) and ruff pass on both changed files.
- Torch-free simulation of `test_openai_streaming.py` at this head: 15 passed, 0 failed, 15 skipped. Without the fix, the new logprobs test fails in 2 of 2 cases.
- Earlier heads on 8×H100:
  - `tests/unit_tests/inference/**` at `72de4874`: 3680 passed, 37 skipped, 0 failed.
  - Full `tests/unit_tests/**/*.py`, merged with `main` `b8305562`: 3424 passed, 142 skipped, 0 failed, then 24 of 24 in the second session.
- GitHub CI on `9bd15b20` is pending.

@@ -282,6 +288,75 @@ async def test_openai_stream_preserves_chat_top_logprobs_with_parser():

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "final_tokens", [[1, 2], [1, 2, 3]], ids=["held-back-tokens", "held-back-and-final-tokens"]
+)
+async def test_openai_stream_keeps_logprobs_of_parser_held_back_text(final_tokens):
+    log_probs = [-0.1, NEG_INF, -0.3]
+    top_log_probs = [{"a": NEG_INF}, {"b": -0.2}, {"c": -0.3}]
+    stream = AsyncStream(request_id=1, cancel=lambda: None)
+    for token in (1, 2):
+        stream.put(
+            {
+                "partial": {
+                    "request_id": 1,
+                    "new_tokens": [token],
+                    "new_log_probs": [log_probs[token - 1]],
+                    "new_top_n_logprobs": [top_log_probs[token - 1]],

+            "final": {
+                "prompt_tokens": [9],
+                "generated_tokens": final_tokens,
+                "generated_log_probs": log_probs[: len(final_tokens)],
+                "generated_top_n_logprobs": top_log_probs[: len(final_tokens)],
+                "sampling_params": {"num_tokens_to_generate": 8},
+            }
+        }
+    )
+    stream.finish()
+

+    expected_text = "abc"[: len(final_tokens)]
+    assert content["choices"][0]["delta"] == {"content": expected_text}
+    # Delaying the text must not drop its logprobs: every token keeps exactly one entry.
+    entries = content["choices"][0]["logprobs"]["content"]
+    assert [entry["token"] for entry in entries] == list(expected_text)
+    assert [entry["logprob"] for entry in entries] == [-0.1, JSON_SAFE_LOGPROB_FLOOR, -0.3][
+        : len(final_tokens)

+    ]

@@ -412,6 +487,94 @@ def test_streaming_chat_parser_handles_single_multi_turn_tool_call_request():

+def _deepseek_parse(text, finished=False):
+    return DeepSeekR1ReasoningParser.parse(text)
+
+
+def _parse_each_prefix(parser, model_output):
+    deltas = []
+    for end in range(1, len(model_output) + 1):
+        deltas.extend(parser.parse(model_output[:end]))
+    deltas.extend(parser.parse(model_output, finished=True))
+    return deltas
+
+
+def _joined(deltas, key):
+    return "".join(delta.get(key, "") for delta in deltas)
+
+
+def test_streaming_chat_parser_holds_partial_reasoning_end_marker():
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(_deepseek_parse)
+
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hel") == [{"reasoning_content": "hel"}]
+    # `</thi` may still become `</think>`, so it is held back instead of committed.
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</thi") == [{"reasoning_content": "lo"}]
+    # The completed marker ends the reasoning; no stale marker text was emitted.
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</think>") == []
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</think>Hi") == [{"content": "Hi"}]
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</think>Hi", finished=True) == []
+
+    # Character by character, partial `<think>` included, the deltas join to the final split.
+    deltas = _parse_each_prefix(StreamingChatParser(_deepseek_parse), "<think>hello</think>Hi")
+    assert _joined(deltas, "reasoning_content") == "hello"
+    assert _joined(deltas, "content") == "Hi"
+
+
+def test_streaming_chat_parser_holds_partial_implicit_reasoning_end_marker():
+    def parse(text, finished=False):
+        return DeepSeekR1ReasoningParser.parse(
+            text, implicit_reasoning_end_markers=("<tool_call>",)
+        )
+
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(parse, marker_prefixes=Qwen3CoderToolParser.streaming_markers)
+
+    assert parser.parse("<think>plan<tool_c") == [{"reasoning_content": "plan"}]
+    # `<tool_call>` ends the reasoning; the tool markup itself stays buffered as content.
+    assert parser.parse("<think>plan<tool_call>") == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "chat_template_kwargs",
+    [{"enable_thinking": False}, {"force_nonempty_content": True}],
+    ids=["thinking-disabled", "force-nonempty"],
+)
+def test_streaming_chat_parser_holds_nemotron_fallback_reasoning(chat_template_kwargs):
+    def parse(text, finished=False):
+        return NemotronV3ReasoningParser.parse(text, chat_template_kwargs=chat_template_kwargs)
+
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(parse)
+    # Until an answer follows `</think>`, Nemotron returns the reasoning as content. Neither
+    # channel may commit it, because it becomes reasoning once the answer starts.
+    for end in range(1, len("hello</think>") + 1):
+        assert parser.parse("hello</think>"[:end]) == []
+    assert parser.parse("hello</think>\n") == [{"reasoning_content": "hello"}, {"content": "\n"}]
+    assert parser.parse("hello</think>\nHi") == [{"content": "Hi"}]
+    assert parser.parse("hello</think>\nHi", finished=True) == []
+
+    # When no answer follows by the end of the stream, the reasoning is the content.
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(parse)
+    assert parser.parse("Hi") == []
+    assert parser.parse("Hi", finished=True) == [{"content": "Hi"}]
+
+
+def test_streaming_chat_parser_streams_nemotron_reasoning_when_not_forced():
+    def parse(text, finished=False):
+        return NemotronV3ReasoningParser.parse(text, chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": True})
+
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(parse)
+
+    assert parser.parse("hel") == [{"reasoning_content": "hel"}]
+    assert parser.parse("hello</think>Hi") == [{"reasoning_content": "lo"}, {"content": "Hi"}]
+
+
+def test_streaming_chat_parser_flushes_literal_partial_reasoning_marker_at_finish():
+    parser = StreamingChatParser(_deepseek_parse)
+
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</thi") == [{"reasoning_content": "hello"}]
+    # The stream ended before the marker completed, so `</thi` is literal reasoning.
+    assert parser.parse("<think>hello</thi", finished=True) == [{"reasoning_content": "</thi"}]
+

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

### [P2] Retain OpenAI logprobs while forced-content deltas are buffered

**Failure:** The new [early return](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/436475833c5ede86b11dafbe73ab90e981f99451/megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/openai_streaming.py#L235-L239) drops the standard OpenAI logprobs for buffered tokens. For example, use `NemotronV3ReasoningParser` with `enable_thinking=False`, stream two partial frames generating `a` and `b` with logprobs, then send a final frame containing the same two tokens. Both partial parses return `[]`. At finalization, `openai_stream` finds no new tokens, sets `logprobs=None`, and emits the buffered `{"content":"ab"}` without its logprobs. The terminal `generation_log_probs` extension does not restore the missing OpenAI `choices[].logprobs.content` entries. This follows directly from the [per-frame attachment logic](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/436475833c5ede86b11dafbe73ab90e981f99451/megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/openai_streaming.py#L468-L510).

**Correction:** Keep the reasoning/content holdback, but retain unattached logprob records in each choice's `openai_stream` state. Consume them once when the parser next emits a textual delta, including a final-only flush. The invariant is that delaying text must not discard its logprob records.

Suggested implementation in [the state initialization](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/436475833c5ede86b11dafbe73ab90e981f99451/megatron/core/inference/text_generation_server/dynamic_text_gen_server/openai_streaming.py#L359-L373) and parser branch, preserving the existing policy of attaching records to the first textual delta:

```python
# Add to each per-choice states entry:
pending_parser_logprobs=None,
```

Replace the parser branch's logprob selection through the assignment to `parsed_logprobs`; retain its existing `yield sse(...)` below:

```python
if parser is not None:
    if logprobs is not None:
        pending = state["pending_parser_logprobs"]
        if pending is None:
            state["pending_parser_logprobs"] = logprobs
        else:
            for key, entries in logprobs.items():
                pending[key].extend(entries)

    parsed_deltas = parser.parse(state["detokenizer"].text, finished=is_final)
    for parsed_delta in parsed_deltas:
        parsed_logprobs = None
        if (
            state["pending_parser_logprobs"] is not None
            and (
                parsed_delta.get("content") is not None
                or parsed_delta.get("reasoning_content") is not None
            )
        ):
            parsed_logprobs = state["pending_parser_logprobs"]
            state["pending_parser_logprobs"] = None
        # Keep the existing yield sse(...) here.
```

**Preservation and acceptance — proposed checks, not executed:**
- Add an async regression alongside [the existing parser/logprob test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/436475833c5ede86b11dafbe73ab90e981f99451/tests/unit_tests/inference/test_openai_streaming.py#L241-L288): partial tokens `[1]`, then `[2]`, followed by final tokens `[1, 2]`, using the existing test tokenizer and forced Nemotron parser. Expect no early text, final content `ab`, and standard logprob entries for both `a` and `b`, in order and exactly once. Include `-inf` and top-logprobs to verify their existing finite-floor conversion survives buffering. Also test a final frame adding token `3`: expect `abc` with all three entries exactly once.
- Retain the existing immediate passthrough assertion: content `a` carries its top-logprob entry with `JSON_SAFE_LOGPROB_FLOOR`. Unparsed streams must retain their existing chunking and logprobs.
- Keep the new reasoning regressions unchanged: forced fallback remains withheld until stable/final, ordinary Nemotron reasoning still emits `hel` immediately, and unfinished literal `</thi` flushes at finish.
- Keep tool-only output free of invented text deltas; retain the existing single tool name/ID and complete JSON argument assertions. Pending records must remain choice-local when multiple streams are interleaved.

Static review only; tests were not executed. The suggested code requires author verification before adoption.
